learning_outcomes.text: Explains the fundamental principles of terrestrial and satellite communication systems.
Compares the types and characteristics of antennas used in satellite communication.
Analyzes waveform forms used in communication systems.
Identifies circuit elements used in terrestrial-satellite communication.
Models and implements a simple satellite communication system.
Develops awareness of modern communication technologies.

assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
